title: Heterogeneous Expression of TREM2 And STAB1 Among Tumor-Associated Macrophages in Clear-Cell Renal Cell Carcinoma.
snippet: Tumor-associated macrophages (TAMs) play important roles in shaping the tumor microenvironment and regulating antitumor immune responses.
